answer: An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the farm spends 3654 minutes and still owns nothing it can sell. The kiln keeps its own log, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two. The workshop keeps the ember, the ledger keeps the timber, time itself keeps the trellis — and none of the three works for the farm. Where the farms spot a gap, Floor tiler floor tile proof fired in the clay pit finds a record, and the record is each floor tile is a season of logged kiln readings plus a signed firing record.
